source_map.hrw_note: Published by HRW, not by Rumoca's Serialize. Rumoca's node carries every registered file's full text; this one carries the id-to-file index for the files this DAE's spans name, and no text. Names are workspace-relative, so source_id_for_name(file) does NOT equal source_id the way Rumoca's own node requires (SPEC_0029 §3a) — resolve a span by its source_id, never by re-deriving one from the name.
